aviso: Cris reading the test script aloud, playing the seller. The script and the store are made up for testing; not a real customer call.
negocio: Role-play: Cris reading the test script

transcripcion.texto: How do customer questions reach you today?
Mostly email and Instagram DMs. It's me and one part-time person, Jordan. Honestly, half my mornings go to "where is my order?"
Half your mornings. Roughly, how many messages a day is that?
Around 40 on a normal day, way more after a launch.
And which questions come up the most?
Shipping times, whether the candles are safe around pets, and returns when a jar arrives cracked.
Got it. If those three got answered automatically, with the hard ones still coming to you, what would that be worth?
If it gave me my mornings back, I could see spending $3 to $500 a month. More than that, I'd need to see it working first.
Fair. Who else would be a part of the decision?
Just me. My business partner Sam signs off on anything over 500.
Before Black Friday, so ideally set up by mid-November.
Okay. Here's what I suggest. I'll send you a short proposal by Friday, and we book 30 minutes next Tuesday to walk through it with Sam.

resumen: The buyer and their part-time assistant handle customer queries via email and Instagram DMs, spending half their mornings on recurring questions. The seller offered automated resolution for common questions. The buyer expressed interest within a $300-$500 monthly budget and wants implementation before Black Friday. The seller will send a proposal by Friday and meet next Tuesday with the buyer and business partner Sam.
